name: Cosmos-Reason2-2B, first 16 text layers
license_note: NVIDIA Open Model License. Gated on the Hub.
notes: Same weights as Cosmos-Reason2-2B with language_model.layers truncated to 16, which is GR00T N1.7's select_layer. The original final norm and lm_head stay. This is the matched control for the GR00T checkpoint, which does not contain the other 12 text layers. Scores are not comparable to the full Cosmos model.
convention: lm-evaluation-harness arc_easy, 0-shot: raw 'Question: {question}\nAnswer:' and each choice text as a continuation; argmax of summed log-probability (acc) and of log-probability per character (acc_norm)
